lobe.name: Svrn7.Signin
lobe.title: SVRN7 Signin LOBE
lobe.description: Generic local-UI wallet-password verification. Any local UI client sharing this TDA's identity (PandoMail, a future PandoBoard, admin tooling) can verify the operator knows this TDA's wallet password before treating a /localcomm-ws connection as signed in. Verification happens entirely inside the TDA host (VerifyWalletPassword) using the same Argon2id + AES-256-GCM decrypt as bootstrap; the password itself travels in plaintext over /localcomm-ws (same as every other local-UI message) but no key material ever crosses back to the client.
lobe.author: Michael Herman

protocols.title: Authenticate (verify wallet password)
protocols.description: Local UI request to verify a candidate wallet password. Body: { password: string }. Replies with AuthResult over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

cmdlets.name: Invoke-Svrn7SigninAuthenticate
cmdlets.title: Authenticate
cmdlets.description: Verifies a candidate wallet password via $SVRN7.VerifyWalletPassword and replies with AuthResult over the WebSocket push channel.

ai._note: Epoch 0: these fields are informational for human and AI developers.
ai.summary: Verifies a local UI client's claimed knowledge of this TDA's wallet password without ever returning key material. Not a server-side access gate for /localcomm-ws (see docs/BACKLOG.md) — the gate is client-side, in whichever app calls this.
useCases: PandoMail's TDA picker requiring a password before showing the mail UI
Any future local-UI app sharing this TDA's identity that wants the same pairing step
compositionHints: Send Authenticate immediately after Hello, before any other protocol call
A wrong password does not lock the caller out server-side beyond an in-memory, per-TDA-process attempt window (separate from the wallet's own restart-persisted UnlockThrottle)
limitations: Password travels in plaintext over /localcomm-ws, same as every other local-UI message (P-008: localhost-only is the trust boundary for this channel).
Not a server-side gate: /localcomm-ws still accepts all local traffic regardless of AuthResult.
